Inflation vs Deflation in Tokenomics 🔁

🟢 Inflationary: Constant token minting (e.g. Dogecoin)
🔴 Deflationary: Token burns or capped supply ( BTC, BNB)

Projects often burn tokens (e.g. Binance) to reduce supply and increase scarcity. Scarcity = potential value driver 💥 https://t.co/GyjvHET0ny
